articles.originalTitle: Google、宇宙AIデータセンター構想「Project Suncatcher」初の試作衛星をFalcon 9で打ち上げへ
articles.topic: Project Suncatcher / TPU / Space AI Infrastructure / Cooling
articles.accessNote: ITmedia NEWS public article text inspected. Launch vehicle, acceleration conditions, vacuum cooling, and future satellite-cluster context were visible.

claims.statement: Project Suncatcher will use a TPU-equipped prototype satellite to validate launch and orbital environmental constraints, including up to 10G on the vehicle and 50–100G on individual components, plus cooling in vacuum.
claims.locator: ITmedia NEWS: launch-load and cooling sections
claims.conditions: This prototype is not an orbital data center. Passing ground vibration tests does not establish full orbital reliability; the launch is intended to gather real-environment data.

articles.originalTitle: ゼロから声を作れる音声生成モデル「Gemini 3.8 Flash TTS」公開　「Gemini Notebook」でも利用可能に
articles.topic: Gemini 3.8 Flash TTS / Voice Replication / Audio AI / Consent
articles.accessNote: ITmedia NEWS public article text inspected. Language coverage, voice creation, 30-second replication sample, consent/voice-match requirements, and dated pricing conditions were visible.

claims.statement: Gemini 3.8 Flash TTS supports 130 languages and Voice Replication from a 30-second sample, but replication is limited to voices the user owns or has rights to use and requires recorded verbal consent plus speaker matching.
claims.conditions: Pricing cited in the article is time-bounded through 2026-12-31 and changes from 2027-01-01; product planning should not treat the current rate as permanent.

articles.accessNote: The public article portion was inspected. It described multi-document summarization/organization and framed Akita Prefecture and Sapporo City examples around existing systems, security, operations, and staff working environments.

claims.statement: The article presents Gemini Notebook as a tool for reading multiple organizational documents and emphasizes that real adoption depends on existing systems, security, operations, and user environments, using Akita and Sapporo examples.
claims.quote: 複数の資料を読み込ませ

claims.conditions: The inspected public portion summarizes case-study themes; it does not by itself prove a universal productivity gain or a single recommended architecture for all organizations.

articles.originalTitle: 生成AIでメール処理が劇的効率化？　ClaudeでGmailが操作できる「Gmailコネクタ」設定と安全な活用法
articles.topic: Claude / Gmail Connector / Email Automation / Human Review
articles.accessNote: The public article introduction was inspected. It explicitly covered Gmail search, summarization, reply drafting, setup, safe-operation rules to prevent mistaken sends, and error handling.

claims.statement: Claude's Gmail Connector can support email search, summarization, and reply drafting from chat, while the article separately treats safe operation and mistaken-send prevention.
claims.conditions: The public portion supports the workflow and safety framing, not a claim that final sending should be fully autonomous or that every Gmail operation is available in every plan.
